Interface AIiTransactionRollbackActionDefinition<IN extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionInput,OUT extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionOutput,AO extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionAttemptOutput,CTX extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionExecutionContext<?>>

Type Parameters:

public interface AIiTransactionRollbackActionDefinition<IN extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionInput,OUT extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionOutput,AO extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionAttemptOutput,CTX extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionExecutionContext<?>>
Predeclared rollback executor and late-bound rollback input factory. Exactly which action effects require undo is decided from immutable journal state, not by modifying the plan after it has started.
